answer_1.quote: Our main contribution is the design and implementation of a new positive reframing task.

answer_2.quote: Following other style transfer work with a parallel corpus, we evaluate our models for semantic similarity with the ground truth using the BLEU, ROUGE, and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: Finally, we conduct human evaluation in which 50 items are distributed to 3 raters who score the reframed sentences for three criteria, each on a scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: The criteria include Meaning Preservation, as well as the Positivity and Fluency of the generated text.
